One long task

Timer20ms

Browser DevTools mastery (used in every phase) · 4/7

The interaction's time

360 ms = 20 ms input delay + 300 ms processing + 40 ms presentation delay

  • 20 ms input delay a timer task was still running
  • 300 ms processing the click handler, a long task
  • 40 ms presentation delay style, layout and paint

Browser DevTools mastery (used in every phase) · 5/7

Why throttle the CPU

No throttling

  • Handler 15 ms
  • Not a long task
  • INP 18 ms

20x slowdown

  • Handler 300 ms
  • Long task
  • INP 360 ms, flagged

Same code, slower CPU, longer tasks.

Browser DevTools mastery (used in every phase) · 6/7

Split the work

Before

  • One 300 ms task
  • Paint waits
  • INP 360 ms

After

  • 40 ms update, then yield
  • Paint, then short tasks
  • INP 100 ms

No task over 50 ms; INP under 200 ms.

Browser DevTools mastery (used in every phase) · 7/7

Layout shifts track

  1. 1Each shift: a purple diamond
  2. 2Nearby shifts: one cluster
  3. 3Good CLS: 0.1 or less

Here is one example trace of a single click.

The Main track is a flame chart.

The x-axis is time.

The y-axis is the call stack.

Events on top cause the events below.

At 20x slowdown the click handler takes 300 milliseconds.

A red triangle marks it,

and the part over 50 milliseconds is red.

The Interactions track splits the click into input delay,

processing time and presentation delay.

Here they add up to 360 milliseconds.

Without throttling, the same handler takes 15 milliseconds and INP is 18.

The 20x slowdown shows what a slower device feels.

Before: one 300 millisecond task.

After: update the page in 40 milliseconds, then yield.

The browser paints, the rest runs in short tasks,

and INP drops to 100.

The Layout shifts track shows each shift

as a purple diamond, grouped in clusters.

Keep CLS at 0.1 or less.
